disgruntled.title: You’re letting a rodent watch you throw away your life in real time. Have some shame.
I hope your comfort zone is cozy, because you’re going to die in it.
Skipping today didn't save you any time; it just brought your failure 24 hours closer.
You treat your own ambitions like suggestions, and wonder why nobody takes you seriously.

eldritch.title: Your life is burning away, little by little.
Every unfinished goal is a little gravestone with your name already carved on it.
Every empty checkmark is proof that you’d rather disappoint yourself than feel uncomfortable for twenty minutes.
You’re letting a rodent watch you throw away your life in real time. Have some shame.
